A model of '''transport''' vessel was used by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TGBS" /> It was a high speed multi purpose transport vessel.<ref name="SWG:DtST">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Destroy the Spice Transport|Dantooine system}}</ref>

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This transport vessel first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''. In the game, the vessel is only identified as the "Hutt Transport".<ref name="SWG:TGBS" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' {{1st}}
